title: Powers of 10 and decimal place value: 10 questions

questions.why: ÷ 100: digits shift right 2 places. Use a zero to hold the place: 0.0325.

questions.q: The digits shift LEFT 2 places. Which operation is it? [img:pow10-shift]
questions.why: Left means bigger. 2 places means 100. So it is × 100.

questions.q: The digits shift RIGHT 1 place. Which operation is it? [img:pow10-shift]
questions.why: Right means smaller. 1 place means 10. So it is ÷ 10.
6.4 → 0.064 moves the digits right 2 places. That is ÷ 100.

questions.q: Final check: In 3.25, the tenths place is ___ the hundredths place. [img:pow10-shift]
questions.why: Every place is 10 times the place to its right. Tenths is left of hundredths, so it is 10 times.
